name: Exact Online REST API
description:
The Exact Online REST API provides access to Exact Online data and functionality. 
        
## Authentication
This API uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication. You will need to authenticate using your Exact Online credentials.

## Division Parameter
Almost all REST API resources require a Division parameter to identify the division being accessed. 
You can get your current division using `/api/v1/current/Me?$select=CurrentDivision`.

## Pagination
Most endpoints have a page size of 60 results per request. Use the $top and $skip parameters for pagination.
Bulk and sync endpoints have a page size of 1000.
